THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FOLK & LANDSCAPE
056
STUDY 029
Red Folk Bodice with a Stork
Rights check
Source: 24537.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with copper-red hair in a
loose braid and pale blue eyes stands in a wheat field
beside a white stork with wings half-open. She wears a
red and cream embroidered bodice with layered pearl
and beaded necklaces, a tan linen blouse with
gathered puff sleeves, and a striped red skirt. A woven
basket sits at her side. Her expression is steady and
direct. Soft, late-afternoon sun under a blue sky. Warm
palette of wheat gold, cream, and crimson. Rustic and
cinematic, in the style of a pastoral fashion editorial.
Rustic, cinematic, warm
WORKING NOTES
- The stork and wheat field set the story; keep them in the
frame.
- Use 'wide shot' to show more of the landscape.
